links.outcome: Omission of predefined critical findings in LLM-generated CT impressions by region and model
links.effect: Critical omissions were uncommon overall but showed model- and region-specific patterns; highest omission rate in abdominal CT for one model. No numeric rates in abstract.
links.quote: Critical omissions were uncommon overall but showed model- and region-specific patterns; the highest omission rate occurred in abdominal CT for one model.

links.outcome: Occasional critical omissions in AI-drafted CT impressions requiring clinician review
links.effect: Occasional critical omissions persist in LLM-generated Turkish CT impressions; authors conclude clinician oversight is required rather than standalone deployment.
links.quote: LLM-generated Turkish CT impressions can reach acceptable quality in selected settings, but occasional critical omissions persist.

links.outcome: LLM impression quality and omissions for Turkish-language (non-English) reports
links.effect: Turkish CT impression quality varied by model and region; acceptable in selected settings but occasional critical omissions persisted.
links.quote: LLM-generated Turkish CT impressions can reach acceptable quality in selected settings, but occasional critical omissions persist.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of multiple LLMs for drafting Turkish radiology impression sections, measuring quality, critical omissions, and readability through radiologist ratings.
